compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
After S2b/S2c, runtime and factories agree, but users still see hand-maintained package help and the old two-family intercept behavior. Canonical generated artifacts may become authoritative only after the complete parser/route census is proven.

## Approach
Add `scripts/gen_cli_help.py` with write and `--check` modes.

- Enumerate canonical/compatibility/hidden routes from the immutable registry; resolve parser factories only in generation/check execution.
- Render with S2a's fixed `prog`, width, formatter, ordering, UTF-8 LF, and trailing-newline policy.
- Write one artifact per canonical help key; exact aliases reuse canonical bytes. Compatibility/hidden spellings render the same argument-definition helpers with approved alias `prog` and replacement epilog.
- Generate the grouped overview from route group/order/visibility plus parser summaries. Canonical visible commands appear once; aliases are annotated rather than duplicated; hidden routes are omitted.
- Fail `--check` on any missing/stale/stray artifact, unresolved factory, non-deterministic second render, registry/parser census mismatch, or generated package-data diff.
- Keep curated explanations/examples inside parser descriptions/epilogs or later editorial reference sections; no hand-authored usage line or option table may be concatenated after generation.

Cut top-level overview/help/unknown routing to the registry and committed artifacts. The lexical pre-scan handles global config-prefix token shape, command identity, `rebar help <command>`, and a first `--help`/`-h` token after the spelling. It must complete before RP-04 snapshot, config parsing/materialization, mount, handler/factory resolution, or optional imports. Free-text `--help` later in argv remains data/handler input as today.

Approved behavior changes: the 21 formerly intercept-only help forms now succeed safely; overview grouping changes; help output becomes deterministic parser-rendered text. Unknown/help streams and exit codes, historical `jira-onboard`, hidden `bridge-status`, and unknown `purge-bridge` remain as specified.

## Compatibility and Rollback
The existing execution ladder remains active. Commit generator, artifacts, route-help lookup, and subprocess tests together. Reverting this task restores the old help family without changing runtime grammar or stored data.

## Testing
Use generator unit tests and real CLI subprocess tests in a fresh attachable checkout. Sentinels raise if help/unknown paths compose an operation snapshot, read config, mount/create a store, resolve a parser/handler, or import heavy optional modules. Assert exact artifact bytes, streams, exit codes, overview uniqueness/grouping, every alias class, malformed global syntax, free-text negative control, and a normal execution control that still crosses operation/mount boundaries.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `scripts/gen_cli_help.py --check` proves every registered help artifact and overview are deterministic, parser-derived, complete, and free of stale/stray resources.
- [ ] Every visible canonical command appears once in the grouped overview; exact aliases reuse bytes and compatibility/hidden/retired spellings follow the approved rules.
- [ ] Both top-level help forms return exact committed generated bytes before operation/config/store/parser/handler/optional-import boundaries.
- [ ] Free-text later `--help`, malformed global syntax, unknown commands, streams, and exit codes match the explicit compatibility contract.
- [ ] A normal execution negative control still reaches RP-04 operation composition and established mount/init behavior through the old execution ladder.
- [ ] No hand-maintained usage or option table remains in package help.
